welcome_lead: Sharing the Planet centres on environment. Latin America's Amazon is a key climate stake.

walkthroughs.body_html: La Amazonia covers nine countries, 6.7 million km². Es el pulmon del planeta. Deforestation threatens biodiversity.
Reciclo, uso transporte publico, evito plasticos. Modals: se deberia, habria que.
